name: Iridic-Pingo
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed petrified remnants of a former biosphere in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
the radiation hotspot bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
